verdict.rationale: Framer's docs describe a built-in AI agent driven by plain-language prompts. It creates pages, sections, copy and visuals, changes typography, brand colors and dark mode, restructures layouts, and makes designs responsive. A CMS agent sets up and updates collections from instructions. External agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can also operate the project, with their changes landing on a reviewable branch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
